id.description: The segment's id, unique in the cut: s<n> for a sentence, r<n> for b-roll.

clip.description: The clip's id: the picture, and the sound unless audio says otherwise.

start.description: Seconds in the trimmed clip where the segment starts.

end.description: Seconds in the trimmed clip where the segment ends.

transition.description: How the segment starts: cut, fade (a cross-fade from the segment before), zoom (a punch-in) or whoosh.

motion.description: kenburns: a slow zoom over the segment; none: still.

from.description: The scale the segment starts at: 1 is the full frame, up to 1.6.

to.description: The scale it ends at; equal to from: a still framing.

ease.description: linear: one steady speed; out: slows down to its end.

seconds.description: How long the move takes from the segment's start, then the picture holds; absent: the whole segment.

anchor.description: The point the zoom keeps still, such as the face's centre; absent: 50 % across, 42 % down.

camera.description: The segment's framing and a slow move over it (a push-in, a pull-out, a settle); drawn alike by the draft and the render.

fadeFrames.description: A fade cut's own length in frames at 30 fps (1-30); absent: the film's fadeFrames. Only on a fade.

audio.description: Sound from another clip or span: a J- or L-cut, or b-roll over speech. Without it, the segment plays its own sound.

clip.description: The clip the sound comes from.

start.description: Seconds in that trimmed clip where the sound starts.

end.description: Seconds in that trimmed clip where the sound ends; end - start equals the segment's length.

ownVolume.description: The picture clip's own sound under it (0-1, default 0: muted).

caption.description: Moves the caption box for the captions that start in this segment (px of the film's frame). Without it, the film's caption box.

bottom.description: The caption box's foot, in px above the frame's foot; anchors the box by its foot and wins over top.

top.description: The caption box's top, in px below the frame's top; used when bottom is absent.

segments.description: The kept parts of the clips, in film order.

overlays.description: Small graphics and emphasis zooms placed on a word of the transcript (at_word) or a film second (at), one at a time, each inside one shot (one segment, or segments of one clip joined by plain cuts, with no Ken Burns zoom and the same caption box; a punch_in inside one segment): punch_in, keyword, lower_third, list, arrow, highlight, search_bar, place_card, counter, date_stamp; and a hook_title at the top, which may stay across cuts beside the others. Without it, none.

kind.description: punch_in (an emphasis zoom on a word), keyword, lower_third, list, arrow, highlight, hook_title, search_bar, place_card, counter or date_stamp.

at_word.description: The transcript word the overlay starts on (its start after the cut); give this or at.

text.description: The word as the transcript has it; compared without case and punctuation.

occurrence.description: Which time the film says it (1 the first, the default).

at.description: The film second the overlay starts at; give this or at_word.

duration.description: Seconds on screen (1-8; a hook_title up to 180).

text.description: The text: keyword (up to 24 characters), lower_third (40), hook_title (64, one or two lines), search_bar (40), place_card title (28) or date_stamp (24).

items.description: The list's points: 2 to 4, up to 32 characters each.

item_words.description: A list only: the word each point comes in on, one per point in order; the points come in one by one.

text.description: The word as the transcript has it; compared without case and punctuation.

occurrence.description: Which time the film says it (1 the first, the default).

item_at.description: A list only, in place of item_words: the film second each point comes in at, one per point in order.

anchor.description: The point an arrow points at, or the rectangle a highlight marks (x, y its top left), in px of the film's frame.

x.description: Px from the frame's left edge.

y.description: Px from the frame's top edge.

place.description: A hook_title's place label above it (drawn with a pin) or a date_stamp's place, e.g. "Hanoi, Vietnam" (up to 40 characters).

subtitle.description: A place_card's one-line subtitle (up to 40 characters).

value.description: The number a counter counts up to (at most two decimals).

from.description: The number a counter counts from (0 by default), below its value.

unit.description: A counter's unit after the number, e.g. km (up to 12 characters).

style.description: The overlay's look: size, side, position, entrance, typing speed and colours; fonts are the brand's.

size.description: s, m (the default) or l: the punch-in's zoom (108, 112, 115 %) or the type size.

side.description: The side a keyword, lower third, list or date stamp sits on.

position.description: top, middle or bottom of the room above the captions: keyword, search_bar, place_card, counter (any), lower_third (top or bottom), list (top or middle).

entrance.description: fade, slide, type (text typed in letter by letter), none, pop (92 % to 100 %, no overshoot), rise (up from 5 % of the height), blur (blurred to sharp) or wipe (card revealed from the left in the accent, then the text); without it the kind's own. Never a bounce.

exit.description: auto (the default: mirrors the entrance), fade, slide (down and out) or none.

easing.description: smooth (the default) or snappy: the curve of the entrance and the exit.

typing_speed.description: Characters per second of a typed entrance or a search bar (4-40, 14 by default).

colors.description: The overlay's own colours in place of the brand's.

card.description: The card's colour (#rrggbb); the brand's background without it.

text.description: The text's colour; the brand's foreground without it.

accent.description: The accent (dot, pin, magnifier, arrow, marker); the brand's accent without it.

corner_radius.description: The card's corner: none, s, m, l or pill; the brand style's without it (no punch_in, arrow or highlight).

align.description: center (the default) or left: how a hook_title's or a place_card's lines sit in their card; left, center or right: where a keyword's card sits across its room (in place of side).

subtitle_size.description: s, m (the default, about 55 % of the title) or l: a place_card's subtitle size.

stagger.description: A list only: its points come in one by one (on item_words when given, else spaced automatically).

list_layout.description: A list only: stack (the default: one centred card growing as each point comes in), chips (each point its own small card in one centred row, entering in turn from the left) or auto (chips when they fit one row, else stack).

subtitle_delay.description: A place_card only: seconds its subtitle waits after its title (0-0.6).

pin.description: A place_card only: none (the default), static or drop (an accent pin above the title that falls a little and stops).

underline.description: A keyword only: an accent bar drawn under the word after it enters.

captionRanges.description: Moves the caption box for the captions said in a stretch of film time (from to to, in film seconds), over the segment's own caption; stretches never overlap. Without it, the segments' boxes.

from.description: Film second where the stretch starts.

to.description: Film second where the stretch ends (excluded).

bottom.description: The caption box's foot, in px above the frame's foot; anchors the box by its foot and wins over top.

top.description: The caption box's top, in px below the frame's top; used when bottom is absent.
